notes.title: Meteoroids 3D now on sale! 63% off!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi! We're happy to inform that Meteoroids 3D new version 1.20 is now on sale! 63% off so you can destroy rockets while bringing some new adjustments to the game, and a new great feature: Unguided rockets.[/b]

Also: we have just added better CPU and GPU enhancements and HDR!

What are unguided rockets? A very powerful weapon that you can use when in a "melee" with the asteroids. Just give the order to shoot ("L" or "X" in an Xbox pad or equivalent or square in PS4/PS5) and you'll find yourself shooting six powerful rockets. 


Remember: rockets are limited, and they will recharge in time (works like the missiles). Aim well and destroy all those meteors at once!

New features are on the way. Also on Xbox Series And Nintendo Switch. [b]Good meteor hunting![/b]

notes.title: Meteoroids 3D has been released!
notes.notes:
[b]Meteoroids 3D has impacted on Steam![/b]

It was going to be a standard day in your life. Then you thought: Destroying rocks in space? Is that funny?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39938969/a064dc3ae8d454f7363b1edd4d4d79bc4526d475.jpg[/img]

Well, Asteroids, the game we played long time ago, was really funny. You must say if Meteoroids 3D, a tribute to Asteroids, is funny. Not at the same level Asteroid was, of course. We don't want nor need to compete against Asteroids. We want to recreate that emotion in a new way.

Time has changed us. Those old games like Asteroids will be forever in our hearth. We can't pretend to emulate those great times with new games. We know the world is different, and we know it because we lived those times: the times of Asteroids. And we can compare both. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39938969/5ff002b082c0c1409e841193de40701216ef1188.jpg[/img]

One thing remains: the joy of playing a simple game and having a good time. But Meteoroids 3D has plenty of new elements to impact in your mind and to prove your skills. We have added many things, including enemies that will make your life harder. Say you want to deactivate them, you just need to go to the config menu and do it. If you want a more modern challenge, let them activated.

There also many new weapons, that will be activated while you play, but then again, it's up to you to play the way you prefer. We give you options: you choose how to play.

Take a look to our main entry here to know more about Meteoroids 3D.

Ready to destroy rocks?

[previewyoutube=9n6mSXbZjhE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Meteoroids 3D: Meteor Fire Arena
notes.notes:
[b]Meteor Fire: when impossible is even better[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39938969/488c578be0f525c90a21a7fd4899e0928ade97f8.png[/img]

Which must be the difficulty of a game to be entertaining? It depends of many factors. Of course, the game should have a switch to choose the difficulty. But there are many people that even the hardest level is not good enough. They want a real challenge. And they're going to find it in Meteoroids 3D.

Meteor Fire is a special arena designed specifically for those who want a real challenge. The game has all the difficulties added to the standard arena, but increased in every level. The result is clear: even the simplest levels will be a challenge. Not to say the final levels; the player will need to be faster than light to finish those levels. Impossible? Yes. That's the reason we've created it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39938969/fcee3604e558ff8b5c6f5430e602960c1a4490b8.png[/img]

In this video Peter talks about Meteor Fire, and show the main elements of this arena. 

We hope you enjoy it. And remember: ready to destroy rocks?

[previewyoutube=wYXUhTsICx0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Main features of Meteoroids 3D
notes.notes:
[b]Meteoroids 3D: a tribute to Asteroids, but more than that.[/b]

Hello to Meteoroids 3D, an action game where you must destroy meteors. This game is inspired in the ancient game Asteroids (Atari, 1979), a game that was a hit when we were children. In fact, we spent many hours playing that beauty long time ago.

Of course, the world has changed, and those black and whites games are gone, except for the incredible emulators we can find to play those games. Then we thought: how could we create a game like Asteroids today?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39938969/912cf5e5e24b0a0accc7bcd002e0bc9fd53f636d.jpg[/img]

[b]This is not Asteroids.[/b]

The first thing to know is that we don't want to be better than Asteroids. This is not Asteroids and we don't intend to be the new Asteroids. This is a tribute to Asteroids, and of course the game wants to be a challenge for the player, but not emulate those old sensations we had when we were children after school. Those times are gone, but we want to remember those times with this game.

What we wanted to create is a game to have a good time while playing, trying to get some records, aand enjoying the stress of getting the best scores across the 24 levels the game has, plus the infinite Athena level. Remember: levels are marked with the 24 greek characters.

[b]New features, and the old way too.[/b]

for that reason Meteoroids 3D is born with Asteroids in mind, but we have added many new features that could be impossible to have in 1979. For that reason we have added different enemies and challenges for the first version, and even more that will come soon after release. 

But, if you want to play Meteoroids the old way, you can deactivate all that stuff, and just try to be the best destroying meteors. Oh, by the way, the UFO will always be there, as it was in Asteroids. The Steam leaderboards and rankings will be always active.

[b]Some videos to see how the game works.[/b]

The best way to see all these elements in action are videos, so we're recording some so you can see how the game works. Remember that there are a configuration panel in the game with many options, including real physics of the ship, or the time you have to destroy meteors. 

Another important features is the DMS (Destroyer Meteor Speed) that you will see in red. You'll see a countdown timer from 20 seconds to zero. And below two numbers: how many meteors you have destroyed in those 20 seconds, and your record that game.

How many meteors can you destroy before the countdown finishes?

[b]Weapons and missiles.[/b]

Last, but not least, you get seven weapons that are being activated while you win levels, and missiles, that are a good resource for those heavy enemies that you'll find in the game.

And that's all for now. Please take a look to the videos for more info. Thank you!
